subject: DI04005011

title.en: Oils and fats—definitions and physical properties
title.gu: Oils તથા Fats—વ્યાખ્યા અને ભૌતિક ગુણધર્મો

h.en: Oils and fats—definitions and physical properties
h.gu: Oils તથા Fats—વ્યાખ્યા અને ભૌતિક ગુણધર્મો

body.en:
Definition

Oils and fats are mainly mixtures of triacylglycerols:esters of glycerol with fatty acids.Oils are generally liquid and fats semisolid/solid at the stated room temperature;the distinction is physical,not a different fundamental ester chemistry.

Physical properties

Most edible oils are less dense than water,immiscible with it and soluble in suitable nonpolar solvents.Viscosity falls as temperature rises.Melting behaviour is a range because of mixed triglycerides;degree of unsaturation,chain length and crystal form affect consistency.Colour,odour,refractive index,specific gravity and cloud/pour behaviour assist quality control.Overheating causes decomposition rather than a useful simple boiling-point test.

Quality indices and uses

Acid value measures titratable free-acid equivalents as mgKOH/g sample;iodine value measures unsaturation as gI2equivalent/100g sample.Saponification value relates to alkali demand and average ester size;these are not merely physical constants.Food formulations,soap,coatings,biodiesel and oleochemical feedstocks require appropriate grades.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Oils તથા fats મુખ્યત્વે triacylglycerolsના mixtures છે: glycerol તથા fatty acidsના esters. Stated room temperatureએ oils સામાન્ય રીતે liquid અને fats semisolid/solid હોય છે;ભેદ physical છે,અલગ મૂળ ester chemistry નહીં.

ભૌતિક ગુણધર્મો

મોટાભાગના edible oils પાણી કરતાં હળવા છે,પાણી સાથે immiscible તથા યોગ્ય nonpolar solventsમાં soluble છે. Temperature વધે ત્યારે viscosity ઘટે છે. Mixed triglycerides હોવાથી melting range હોય છે;unsaturation,chain length તથા crystal form consistencyને અસર કરે છે. Colour,odour,refractive index,specific gravity તથા cloud/pour behaviour quality controlમાં ઉપયોગી છે. Overheatingથી decomposition થાય છે,સામાન્ય boiling-point test ઉપયોગી નથી.

Quality Indices તથા ઉપયોગો

Acid value sampleના free-acid equivalentsને mgKOH/gમાં તથા iodine value unsaturationને gI2equivalent/100gમાં બતાવે છે. Saponification value alkali demand તથા average ester size સાથે સંબંધિત છે;આ ફક્ત physical constants નથી. Food formulations,soap,coatings,biodiesel તથા oleochemical feed માટે યોગ્ય grades જોઈએ.

body.en:
Definition

Carbohydrates are polyhydroxy aldehydes/ketones and substances that yield them on hydrolysis.The historical hydrate-of-carbon formula is not a sufficient definition for every member.

Classification first

Monosaccharides cannot be hydrolysed to simpler carbohydrates:glucose,fructose;classify them also as aldoses/ketoses and by carbon number.Oligosaccharides yield a few monosaccharides:disaccharides sucrose,maltose,lactose.Polysaccharides include starch,cellulose and glycogen.Starch contains amylose and branched amylopectin;cellulose has different glycosidic linkage and is not digested like starch by humans.

Reducing behaviour and industrial role

Glucose and maltose are reducing sugars;unhydrolysed sucrose is non-reducing.Sucrose hydrolysis gives glucose+fructose;starch hydrolysis progressively gives dextrins,shorter sugars and ultimately glucose.Sugar is a sweetener/fermentation feed;starch is a food/thickener/binder feed;dextrins serve adhesives and formulations.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Polyhydroxy aldehydes/ketones તથા hydrolysisથી એવા compounds આપતાં પદાર્થો carbohydrates છે. Historical hydrate-of-carbon formula દરેક member માટે પૂરતી વ્યાખ્યા નથી.

વર્ગીકરણ

Monosaccharides સરળ carbohydratesમાં hydrolyse થતા નથી: glucose,fructose;તેમને aldose/ketose તથા carbon numberથી પણ classify કરી શકાય. Oligosaccharides થોડા monosaccharides આપે છે: sucrose,maltose,lactose disaccharides છે. Polysaccharidesમાં starch,cellulose,glycogen આવે છે. Starchમાં amylose તથા branched amylopectin છે;celluloseની glycosidic linkage જુદી છે અને humans તેને starchની જેમ digest કરતા નથી.

Reducing Behaviour તથા Industrial Role

Glucose તથા maltose reducing sugars છે;unhydrolysed sucrose non-reducing છે. Sucrose hydrolysisથી glucose+fructose મળે છે;starch hydrolysisમાં ક્રમશઃ dextrins,short sugars તથા અંતે glucose બને છે. Sugar sweetener/fermentation feed,starch food/thickener/binder તથા dextrins adhesives/formulationsમાં વપરાય છે.

body.en:
Definition and selected route

Vegetable-oil production separates triglyceride oil from cleaned oil-bearing seeds and refines it to the required grade.

Raw materials and chemical principle

Oilseeds,approved extraction solvent,water,refining alkali,bleaching media and steam as appropriate.

Extraction/refining are mainly physical separations;alkali neutralisation converts free fatty acids to soapstock.

Your supplied drawing—page 20

Owner page20is right-clipped.New complete study flow preserves extraction,solvent recovery and refining duties;meal and oil are separate streams.

Complete labelled study flowsheet

1. Seed preparation,pressing and extraction

The reference cleaning/dehulling and cracking rolls expose oil-bearing tissue.Prepared seed can first pass through an expeller,leaving oil-depleted cake and expressed crude oil.The cake enters a solvent extractor;oil dissolves in solvent as miscella,while wet meal leaves separately.Pressing and extraction can be combined or selected by feed.The new drawing keeps the solids and miscella branches distinct.

2. Solvent removal and recovery

Wet meal is desolventised before approved meal handling.Miscella passes through the flash-film evaporation and stripping functions shown in the PDF,so solvent is removed from crude oil and condensed for recycle.Steam stripping removes residual volatile solvent.The solvent loop reduces fresh demand but needs containment,leak control and a qualified purge;unstripped meal/oil is not a finished food product.

3. Neutralising,bleaching and finishing

Crude oil is degummed/neutralised as selected,and centrifuging removes soapstock.Further mixing with bleaching earth/carbon followed by filtration removes colour bodies and fine impurities.Vacuum steam deodorisation removes selected volatile odours.The supplied page is clipped at its right edge;the complete study flow adds the necessary finished-oil boundary without claiming its missing labels were legible.

Engineering and quality considerations

Control seed moisture,solvent fire/explosion risk,residual solvent,oil loss in meal/soapstock,oxidation and grade testing.

Properties / applications

Refined food oils,soap/oleochemical feed and other specified technical grades;quality depends on fatty-acid profile and impurity limits.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા પસંદ કરેલી Route

Cleaned oil-bearing seedsમાંથી triglyceride oil અલગ કરીને જરૂરી grade સુધી refine કરવું એટલે vegetable-oil production.

કાચો માલ તથા રાસાયણિક સિદ્ધાંત

Oilseeds,approved extraction solvent,water,refining alkali,bleaching media તથા જરૂરી steam લેવાય છે.

Extraction/refining are mainly physical separations;alkali neutralisation converts free fatty acids to soapstock.

તમે મોકલેલું Drawing—પાનું 20

મૂળ drawingના equipment names અને દેખાતા connections પ્રમાણે નીચે working સમજાવ્યું છે. Faint/clipped ભાગ માટે complete study redraw પણ આપ્યો છે;અસ્પષ્ટ labelsને અંદાજથી exact design માન્યાં નથી.

સંપૂર્ણ Labelled Study Flowsheet

1. Seed Preparation,Pressing તથા Extraction

Referenceના cleaning/dehulling તથા cracking rollsથી oil-bearing tissue ખુલ્લું થાય છે. Prepared seed expellerમાં જઈ expressed crude oil તથા oil-depleted cake આપે છે. Cake solvent extractorમાં જાય છે;oil solventમાં ઓગળી miscella બનાવે છે અને wet meal અલગ નીકળે છે. Feed મુજબ pressing/extraction જોડાઈ કે અલગ પસંદ થાય છે. નવા drawingમાં solids તથા miscella branches જુદાં છે.

2. Solvent Removal તથા Recovery

Wet mealનું approved handling પહેલાં desolventising થાય છે. PDFની flash-film evaporation તથા stripping functionsથી miscellaમાંથી solvent જુદું પડે છે અને condense થઈ recycle થાય છે. Steam stripping residual solvent દૂર કરે છે. Loop fresh demand ઘટાડે છે,પણ containment,leak control તથા qualified purge જોઈએ;unstripped meal/oil finished food product નથી.

3. Neutralising,Bleaching તથા Finishing

Selected degumming/neutralisation પછી centrifuge soapstock અલગ કરે છે. Bleaching earth/carbon સાથે mixing અને filtrationથી colour bodies/fine impurities દૂર થાય છે. Vacuum steam deodorisation પસંદ કરેલા volatile odours દૂર કરે છે. મૂળ પાનું જમણી બાજુ clipped છે;complete flow finished-oil boundary બતાવે છે,પણ ગુમ labels વાંચી શક્યાં એવો દાવો નથી.

Engineering તથા Quality બાબતો

Seed moisture,solvent fire/explosion risk,residual solvent,meal/soapstockમાં oil loss,oxidation તથા grade testing નિયંત્રિત કરવા.

ગુણધર્મો તથા ઉપયોગો

Refined food oils,soap/oleochemical feed તથા specified technical grades;quality fatty-acid profile/impurity limits પર આધારિત છે.

notes.reaction: Extraction/refining are mainly physical separations;alkali neutralisation converts free fatty acids to soapstock.

body.en:
Definition and selected route

Oil hydrogenation adds hydrogen across some carbon–carbon double bonds to increase saturation and change melting/texture properties.

Raw materials and chemical principle

Refined oil,hydrogen and a suitable controlled catalyst system,commonly nickel-based in the historical process.

–CH=CH– + H2 → –CH2–CH2–;extent of reaction controls the product.

Your supplied drawing—page 19

Partial hydrogenation can produce trans fatty acids;historical process description is not dietary advice or regulatory approval.

Complete labelled study flowsheet

1. Oil and catalyst feed

Pretreatment removes catalyst poisons,moisture and impurities.Catalyst is dispersed into the oil and fed to the agitated hydrogenator.The reference shows an oil/catalyst slurry system,recovered catalyst and make-up nickel;only qualified reusable material returns.Hydrogen contacting and heat removal permit controlled conversion rather than uncontrolled overheating.

2. Reaction and catalyst separation

Hydrogen adsorbs on the catalyst and reacts with unsaturated fatty-acid chains.Increasing saturation generally increases consistency/melting range,but isomerisation and selectivity also affect properties.After the intended conversion,the catalyst separator removes metal-bearing particles;the product is not released merely because it appears solid.

3. Deodorising and final polishing

The supplied vacuum-column deodorisation stage uses heating trays/steam and vacuum service to remove volatiles.Polishing with approved filter aids/earth/carbon and filtration controls residual colour/particles.Cooling gives the required fat texture.Partial hydrogenation may generate trans fatty acids;this historical route is not a recommendation to use noncompliant food formulations.

Engineering and quality considerations

Control hydrogen containment,catalyst removal,oxidation,degree of conversion and current food-compliance testing;spent catalyst requires approved handling.

Properties / applications

Specified fats for permitted food/technical uses;product identity depends on saturation,trans-isomer content and current grade requirements.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા પસંદ કરેલી Route

Oilના કેટલાક carbon–carbon double bonds પર hydrogen ઉમેરવાથી saturation તથા melting/texture બદલાય છે;તે oil hydrogenation છે.

કાચો માલ તથા રાસાયણિક સિદ્ધાંત

Refined oil,hydrogen તથા historical processમાં સામાન્ય nickel-based controlled catalyst system લેવાય છે.

–CH=CH– + H2 → –CH2–CH2–;extent of reaction controls the product.

તમે મોકલેલું Drawing—પાનું 19

મૂળ drawingના equipment names અને દેખાતા connections પ્રમાણે નીચે working સમજાવ્યું છે. Faint/clipped ભાગ માટે complete study redraw પણ આપ્યો છે;અસ્પષ્ટ labelsને અંદાજથી exact design માન્યાં નથી.

સંપૂર્ણ Labelled Study Flowsheet

1. Oil તથા Catalyst Feed

Pretreatment catalyst poisons,moisture તથા impurities દૂર કરે છે. Catalyst oilમાં disperse થઈ agitated hydrogenatorમાં જાય છે. Referenceમાં slurry,recovered catalyst તથા make-up nickel છે;ફક્ત qualified reusable material પાછું જાય છે. Hydrogen contacting તથા heat removalથી controlled conversion થાય છે,uncontrolled overheating નહીં.

2. Reaction તથા Catalyst Separation

Hydrogen catalyst પર adsorb થઈ unsaturated fatty-acid chains સાથે react કરે છે. Saturation વધે ત્યારે સામાન્ય રીતે consistency/melting range વધે છે,પણ isomerisation/selectivity પણ અસર કરે છે. Intended conversion પછી catalyst separator metal-bearing particles દૂર કરે છે;ફક્ત solid દેખાય એટલે release નથી થતું.

3. Deodorising તથા Final Polishing

મૂળ vacuum-column deodoriserમાં heating trays/steam તથા vacuumથી volatiles દૂર થાય છે. Approved filter aids/earth/carbon તથા filtrationથી colour/particles નિયંત્રિત થાય છે. Coolingથી fat texture મળે છે. Partial hydrogenationથી trans fatty acids બની શકે છે;આ historical route noncompliant food formulationની ભલામણ નથી.

Engineering તથા Quality બાબતો

Hydrogen containment,catalyst removal,oxidation,conversion તથા current food-compliance testing જરૂરી;spent catalystનું approved handling કરવું.

ગુણધર્મો તથા ઉપયોગો

Permitted food/technical uses માટે specified fats;saturation,trans-isomers તથા current grade requirements મુજબ product identity નક્કી થાય છે.

notes.reaction: –CH=CH– + H2 → –CH2–CH2–;extent of reaction controls the product.

body.en:
Definition and selected route

Cane-sugar manufacture extracts sucrose-containing juice,clarifies/concentrates it and separates sucrose crystals from mother liquor.

Raw materials and chemical principle

Sugar cane,imbibition water and the selected clarification chemicals;the supplied reference labels lime,phosphate and SO2service.

Main process is extraction/separation/crystallisation;avoid unwanted sucrose inversion:C12H22O11 + H2O → glucose + fructose.

Your supplied drawing—page 18

Reference page18is clipped at right;new flow completes vacuum-pan and product finishing.

Complete labelled study flowsheet

1. Cane preparation and juice extraction

The cutter/crusher prepares cane for the series of pressure rolls.Water applied as imbibition displaces remaining juice from fibre.The juice goes to clarification while bagasse leaves as fibrous residue,often used under approved boiler/other arrangements.The material passing through the juice route is not intact cane fibre.

2. Clarification and evaporation

Heating and controlled clarification chemistry coagulate/precipitate impurities.The clarifier separates clean juice from sludge;rotary filtration recovers juice from sludge and removes filter cake.Multiple-effect evaporation concentrates the clarified liquor while reusing vapour heat between effects.Wrong pH or excessive heating can cause inversion,colour and scale.

3. Vacuum boiling and crystal finishing

Vacuum-pan boiling produces controlled supersaturation and crystal growth.The crystalliser develops the crystal population before centrifuging separates sugar from mother liquor.Mother liquor is further processed where economic;final residual liquor is molasses.Crystals are dried/graded for storage.The new flow completes the right-clipped reference instead of treating molasses as crystallised sugar.

Engineering and quality considerations

Control extraction loss,pH,colour,scale,vacuum,seed/crystal distribution and moisture;manage high-organic-load liquid wastes.

Properties / applications

Crystalline sugar as sweetener/feed;bagasse and molasses are distinct co-products for suitable energy,fibre and fermentation uses.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા પસંદ કરેલી Route

Sugar-cane juice extract કરીને clarify/concentrate કરવું તથા mother liquorથી sucrose crystals અલગ કરવા એટલે cane-sugar manufacture.

કાચો માલ તથા રાસાયણિક સિદ્ધાંત

Sugar cane,imbibition water તથા selected clarification chemicals;referenceમાં lime,phosphate તથા SO2service છે.

Main process is extraction/separation/crystallisation;avoid unwanted sucrose inversion:C12H22O11 + H2O → glucose + fructose.

તમે મોકલેલું Drawing—પાનું 18

મૂળ drawingના equipment names અને દેખાતા connections પ્રમાણે નીચે working સમજાવ્યું છે. Faint/clipped ભાગ માટે complete study redraw પણ આપ્યો છે;અસ્પષ્ટ labelsને અંદાજથી exact design માન્યાં નથી.

સંપૂર્ણ Labelled Study Flowsheet

1. Cane Preparation તથા Juice Extraction

Cutter/crusher caneને pressure-roll series માટે તૈયાર કરે છે. Imbibition water fibreમાંથી બાકી juice બહાર કાઢે છે. Juice clarificationમાં જાય છે,જ્યારે bagasse fibrous residue તરીકે અલગ થાય છે અને approved boiler/other usesમાં જઈ શકે છે. Juice routeમાં intact cane fibre આગળ જતું નથી.

2. Clarification તથા Evaporation

Heating તથા controlled clarification chemistry impurities coagulate/precipitate કરે છે. Clarifier clean juiceને sludgeથી જુદું કરે છે;rotary filtration sludgeમાંથી juice recover કરીને filter cake કાઢે છે. Multiple-effect evaporation effects વચ્ચે vapour heat વાપરી liquor concentrate કરે છે. Wrong pH/excess heatingથી inversion,colour તથા scale થઈ શકે.

3. Vacuum Boiling તથા Crystal Finishing

Vacuum-pan boiling controlled supersaturation તથા crystal growth આપે છે. Crystalliser પછી centrifuge sugarને mother liquorથી અલગ કરે છે. Economic હોય ત્યાં mother liquor ફરી process થાય છે;છેલ્લું residual liquor molasses છે. Crystals dry/grade થઈ store થાય છે. New flow clipped reference પૂર્ણ કરે છે;molassesને crystallised sugar ગણતું નથી.

Engineering તથા Quality બાબતો

Extraction loss,pH,colour,scale,vacuum,crystal distribution/moisture નિયંત્રિત કરવા;high-organic-load liquid wastesનું treatment કરવું.

ગુણધર્મો તથા ઉપયોગો

Crystalline sugar sweetener/feed માટે;bagasse તથા molasses યોગ્ય energy,fibre/fermentation usesના જુદા co-products છે.

notes.reaction: Main process is extraction/separation/crystallisation;avoid unwanted sucrose inversion:C12H22O11 + H2O → glucose + fructose.

body.en:
Definition and selected route

Maize-starch manufacture separates starch granules from germ,fibre and protein by wet milling and density/size separation.

Raw materials and chemical principle

Clean maize,controlled steeping water/media and washing water.

Primarily physical separation;starch remains a polysaccharide rather than being intentionally converted to glucose.

Your supplied drawing—page 17

Right-clipped reference.New flow keeps germ,fibre,gluten and starch outlets distinct.

Complete labelled study flowsheet

1. Steeping and germ separation

The reference air cleaner removes light dirt.Corn is steeped in the controlled warm-water/approved steeping system to soften kernels and loosen components.Steep liquor is a separate stream.Coarse grinding frees oil-rich germ,which is separated before fine milling;otherwise excessive breakage can contaminate the starch route with oil.

2. Fine milling,screening and centrifugation

The wet burstone/fine-mill duty releases starch and protein from remaining tissue.Nylon screening/washing removes hull and fibre.The two-stage centrifuge function separates dense starch-rich suspension from lighter gluten-rich protein;the term gluten here is the corn protein co-product,not an assertion of wheat-gluten identity.

3. Washing,dewatering and drying

Repeated washing improves starch purity.Rotary filtration/pressing removes water from the starch milk before drying;the drying duty avoids unwanted gelatinisation/degradation.The supplied right-hand finishing area is clipped,so the complete redraw separates starch finishing from steep-water and co-product handling.

Engineering and quality considerations

Control microbial quality,steep consistency,germ/fibre/protein separation,water reuse and dryer temperature;co-products are not pure starch.

Properties / applications

Food thickeners,adhesives,paper/textiles and feeds for glucose/dextrin manufacture according to grade.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા પસંદ કરેલી Route

Wet milling તથા density/size separationથી maizeના starch granulesને germ,fibre/proteinથી અલગ કરવા એટલે maize-starch manufacture.

કાચો માલ તથા રાસાયણિક સિદ્ધાંત

Clean maize,controlled steeping water/media તથા washing water લેવાય છે.

Primarily physical separation;starch remains a polysaccharide rather than being intentionally converted to glucose.

તમે મોકલેલું Drawing—પાનું 17

મૂળ drawingના equipment names અને દેખાતા connections પ્રમાણે નીચે working સમજાવ્યું છે. Faint/clipped ભાગ માટે complete study redraw પણ આપ્યો છે;અસ્પષ્ટ labelsને અંદાજથી exact design માન્યાં નથી.

સંપૂર્ણ Labelled Study Flowsheet

1. Steeping તથા Germ Separation

Reference air cleaner light dirt દૂર કરે છે. Controlled warm-water/approved steepingથી kernels soften થાય છે અને components છૂટા પડે છે. Steep liquor અલગ stream છે. Coarse grindingથી oil-rich germ મુક્ત થઈ fine milling પહેલાં અલગ પડે છે;અતિ breakageથી oil starch routeમાં જઈ શકે છે.

2. Fine Milling,Screening તથા Centrifugation

Wet burstone/fine-mill duty બાકી tissueમાંથી starch/protein મુક્ત કરે છે. Nylon screening/washing hull તથા fibre દૂર કરે છે. Two-stage centrifuge dense starch-rich suspensionને lighter gluten-rich proteinથી જુદું કરે છે;અહીં gluten corn-protein co-product છે,wheat-gluten સમાન હોવાનો દાવો નહીં.

3. Washing,Dewatering તથા Drying

Repeated washingથી starch purity વધે છે. Rotary filtration/pressing starch milkનું water ઘટાડે છે;dryingમાં unwanted gelatinisation/degradation ટાળાય છે. Referenceનો right finishing ભાગ clipped છે,એટલે redraw starch finishingને steep-water/co-product handlingથી અલગ પૂર્ણ કરે છે.

Engineering તથા Quality બાબતો

Microbial quality,steeping,germ/fibre/protein separation,water reuse તથા drying નિયંત્રિત કરવા;co-products pure starch નથી.

ગુણધર્મો તથા ઉપયોગો

Grade મુજબ food thickeners,adhesives,paper/textiles તથા glucose/dextrin manufactureના feedમાં ઉપયોગ.

body.en:
Definition and selected route

Dextrins are lower-chain-length starch-conversion products obtained by controlled partial depolymerisation,not complete hydrolysis to glucose.

Raw materials and chemical principle

Starch and the controlled acid-assisted gas/heat system in the supplied fluid-bed route.

Starch → shorter-chain dextrins by partial chain cleavage/rearrangement;no single unique dextrin molecular formula.

Your supplied drawing—page 16

Reference fluid-bed acid-assisted starch depolymerisation;not complete conversion to glucose.

Complete labelled study flowsheet

1. Feed and fluid-bed contact

Conditioned starch enters the fluid-bed depolymeriser.The process gas suspends/contacts particles,improving heat transfer and reducing local hot spots.The reference acid sparger and steam-heated gas-conditioning circuit supply the chosen catalytic/thermal environment;they are not a manual laboratory acid-addition recipe.

2. Partial conversion and gas recovery

Controlled thermal exposure and acidity reduce chain length to the target solubility/viscosity behaviour.Cyclone separation captures entrained fines while the plate-coil exchanger removes/reuses heat from gas.The reference shows conditioned fluidising gas recycle;an appropriate purge avoids accumulation.Different conversion severity gives different dextrin grades.

3. Cooling and product checks

Converted material is cooled/conditioned before packing.Residual acidity,moisture,colour,solubility and viscosity are checked against grade.Overconversion would move the product toward smaller sugars and excessive darkening rather than the desired dextrin.

Engineering and quality considerations

Control dust ignition/containment,heat distribution,conversion and gas/acid emissions;no arbitrary reactor conditions are supplied.

Properties / applications

Adhesives,paper/textile finishing,binders and grade-specific formulations;food uses require approved grades.

Controlled partial depolymerisationથી starchની chain length ઘટીને dextrins બને છે;આ complete glucose hydrolysis નથી.

કાચો માલ તથા રાસાયણિક સિદ્ધાંત

Starch તથા supplied fluid-bed routeની controlled acid-assisted gas/heat system લેવાય છે.

Starch → shorter-chain dextrins by partial chain cleavage/rearrangement;no single unique dextrin molecular formula.

સંપૂર્ણ Labelled Study Flowsheet

1. Feed તથા Fluid-bed Contact

Conditioned starch fluid-bed depolymeriserમાં જાય છે. Process gas particlesને suspend/contact કરીને heat transfer સુધારે છે અને hot spots ઘટાડે છે. Reference acid sparger તથા steam-heated gas-conditioning circuit પસંદ કરેલું catalytic/thermal environment આપે છે;તે manual laboratory acid-addition recipe નથી.

2. Partial Conversion તથા Gas Recovery

Controlled thermal exposure/acidityથી target solubility/viscosity માટે chain length ઘટે છે. Cyclone entrained fines પકડે છે અને plate-coil exchanger gasની heat દૂર/reuse કરે છે. Reference conditioned fluidising-gas recycle બતાવે છે;purge accumulation રોકે છે. Conversion severity મુજબ dextrin grades જુદા પડે છે.

3. Cooling તથા Product Checks

Converted material pack કરતાં પહેલાં cool/condition થાય છે. Residual acidity,moisture,colour,solubility તથા viscosity grade પ્રમાણે ચકાસાય છે. Overconversionથી desired dextrinને બદલે નાના sugars તથા excessive darkening મળે છે.

Dust ignition/containment,heat distribution,conversion તથા gas/acid emissions નિયંત્રિત કરવા;arbitrary reactor conditions આપેલ નથી.

Adhesives,paper/textile finishing,binders તથા grade-specific formulations;food uses માટે approved grades જરૂરી.

body.en:
Sources and classification

Seawater is a dilute mixed-electrolyte resource;evaporation concentrates brine and produces salt/bittern streams.Principal recovered products include NaCl,magnesium compounds,bromine and selected potassium salts,depending on brine composition and the recovery system.Seawater desalination also gives water butdoes not mean every dissolved ion is economically recovered.

Routes and uses

Salt is recovered by evaporation/crystallisation;magnesium can be precipitated as hydroxide and further processed;bromide is oxidised to recover bromine.NaCl serves food/chemical/chlor-alkali industries,magnesium compounds serve refractory/chemical uses,and bromine serves specialised chemical intermediates.Uncontrolled seawater discharge after chemical treatment is not acceptable merely because its original source was the sea.

Sources તથા વર્ગીકરણ

Composition/system પ્રમાણે NaCl,magnesium compounds,bromine તથા selected potassium salts મળે છે. Desalinationથી water પણ મળે છે,પરંતુ દરેક dissolved ionનું economic recovery થાય એવો અર્થ નથી.

Routes તથા Uses

Salt evaporation/crystallisationથી,magnesium hydroxide precipitation તથા further processingથી અને bromide oxidationથી bromine recover થાય છે. NaCl food/chemical/chlor-alkali industriesમાં,magnesium compounds refractory/chemical usesમાં તથા bromine specialised intermediatesમાં વપરાય છે. Chemical treatment પછી uncontrolled discharge મૂળ seawater હતું એટલે યોગ્ય બનતું નથી.

body.en:
Definition and selected route

Bromine recovery from seawater converts dissolved bromide to volatile molecular bromine and concentrates/purifies it in an enclosed industrial recovery train.

Raw materials and chemical principle

Seawater bromide,controlled acid/oxidant systems,air and the selected absorption chemistry.

2Br− + Cl2 → Br2 + 2Cl−;Br2 + SO2 + 2H2O → 2HBr + H2SO4(representative concentration chemistry).

Complete labelled study flowsheet

1. Acidification and oxidation

The seawater feed is conditioned in a corrosion-resistant,closed system.Acidification suppresses competing alkaline reactions;controlled oxidation converts bromide to Br2.Because seawater bromide is dilute,the process must handle much water and recover bromine efficiently rather than treating the feed as a concentrated bromide solution.

2. Air stripping and concentration

Air blowing transfers volatile bromine from the large water stream into a smaller gas stream.In the selected representative route,a controlled SO2/water absorber reduces bromine back to bromide in a more concentrated liquid.Reoxidation subsequently releases bromine from that concentrated liquor.The absorption chemistry is one industrial route,not a student extraction procedure.

3. Closed recovery and finishing

Steam stripping/condensation and phase/purity control recover bromine for compatible closed storage.Captured gases and treated/debrominated water follow authorised emission/effluent routes.Bromine is volatile,corrosive and highly hazardous;the flowsheet gives no operating charges or procedure for self-preparation.

Engineering and quality considerations

Control oxidant demand,corrosion,bromine losses,gas capture and environmental compliance;the provided PDF has no matching bromine sheet,so this new diagram is used.

Properties / applications

Specialised brominated intermediates and approved industrial applications;not unsupervised handling.

Dissolved bromideને volatile molecular bromineમાં ફેરવી enclosed industrial recovery trainમાં concentrate/purify કરવું એટલે seawaterમાંથી bromine recovery.

કાચો માલ તથા રાસાયણિક સિદ્ધાંત

Seawater bromide,controlled acid/oxidant systems,air તથા selected absorption chemistry લેવાય છે.

2Br− + Cl2 → Br2 + 2Cl−;Br2 + SO2 + 2H2O → 2HBr + H2SO4(representative concentration chemistry).

સંપૂર્ણ Labelled Study Flowsheet

1. Acidification તથા Oxidation

Seawater feed corrosion-resistant closed systemમાં condition થાય છે. Acidification competing alkaline reactions ઘટાડે છે અને controlled oxidation bromideને Br2માં ફેરવે છે. Seawaterમાં bromide dilute હોવાથી ઘણું water handle કરીને efficient recovery કરવું પડે છે;feedને concentrated bromide solution માનવો નહીં.

2. Air Stripping તથા Concentration

Air blowingથી volatile bromine મોટા water streamમાંથી નાના gas streamમાં જાય છે. Selected routeમાં controlled SO2/water absorber bromineને વધુ concentrated liquidમાં પાછું bromide બનાવે છે. ત્યારબાદ reoxidationથી concentrated liquorમાંથી bromine છૂટે છે. આ industrial route છે,student extraction procedure નહીં.

3. Closed Recovery તથા Finishing

Steam stripping/condensation તથા phase/purity controlથી bromine compatible closed storageમાં મળે છે. Captured gases તથા treated/debrominated water authorised emission/effluent routesમાં જાય છે. Bromine volatile,corrosive તથા highly hazardous છે;આ flowsheet self-preparation માટે operating charges/procedure આપતું નથી.

Engineering તથા Quality બાબતો

Oxidant demand,corrosion,bromine loss,gas capture તથા environmental compliance જરૂરી;PDFમાં matching bromine sheet ન હોવાથી નવું diagram વાપર્યું છે.

Specialised brominated intermediates તથા approved industrial applications;unsupervised handling માટે નહીં.

q.en: Explain the principle of Oils and fats—definitions and physical properties.
q.gu: Oils તથા Fats—વ્યાખ્યા અને ભૌતિક ગુણધર્મોનો સિદ્ધાંત સમજાવો.

a.en: Oils and fats are mainly mixtures of triacylglycerols:esters of glycerol with fatty acids.Oils are generally liquid and fats semisolid/solid at the stated room temperature;the distinction is physical,not a different fundamental ester chemistry. Most edible oils are less dense than water,immiscible with it and soluble in suitable nonpolar solvents.Viscosity falls as temperature rises.Melting behaviour is a range because of mixed triglycerides;degree of unsaturation,chain length and crystal form affect consistency.Colour,odour,refractive index,specific gravity and cloud/pour behaviour assist quality control.Overheating causes decomposition rather than a useful simple boiling-point test.
a.gu: Oils તથા fats મુખ્યત્વે triacylglycerolsના mixtures છે: glycerol તથા fatty acidsના esters. Stated room temperatureએ oils સામાન્ય રીતે liquid અને fats semisolid/solid હોય છે;ભેદ physical છે,અલગ મૂળ ester chemistry નહીં. મોટાભાગના edible oils પાણી કરતાં હળવા છે,પાણી સાથે immiscible તથા યોગ્ય nonpolar solventsમાં soluble છે. Temperature વધે ત્યારે viscosity ઘટે છે. Mixed triglycerides હોવાથી melting range હોય છે;unsaturation,chain length તથા crystal form consistencyને અસર કરે છે. Colour,odour,refractive index,specific gravity તથા cloud/pour behaviour quality controlમાં ઉપયોગી છે. Overheatingથી decomposition થાય છે,સામાન્ય boiling-point test ઉપયોગી નથી.

q.en: Explain the principle of Carbohydrates—definition and classification.

a.en: Carbohydrates are polyhydroxy aldehydes/ketones and substances that yield them on hydrolysis.The historical hydrate-of-carbon formula is not a sufficient definition for every member. Monosaccharides cannot be hydrolysed to simpler carbohydrates:glucose,fructose;classify them also as aldoses/ketoses and by carbon number.Oligosaccharides yield a few monosaccharides:disaccharides sucrose,maltose,lactose.Polysaccharides include starch,cellulose and glycogen.Starch contains amylose and branched amylopectin;cellulose has different glycosidic linkage and is not digested like starch by humans.
a.gu: Polyhydroxy aldehydes/ketones તથા hydrolysisથી એવા compounds આપતાં પદાર્થો carbohydrates છે. Historical hydrate-of-carbon formula દરેક member માટે પૂરતી વ્યાખ્યા નથી. Monosaccharides સરળ carbohydratesમાં hydrolyse થતા નથી: glucose,fructose;તેમને aldose/ketose તથા carbon numberથી પણ classify કરી શકાય. Oligosaccharides થોડા monosaccharides આપે છે: sucrose,maltose,lactose disaccharides છે. Polysaccharidesમાં starch,cellulose,glycogen આવે છે. Starchમાં amylose તથા branched amylopectin છે;celluloseની glycosidic linkage જુદી છે અને humans તેને starchની જેમ digest કરતા નથી.

q.en: Explain the principle of Vegetable oil from seeds.

a.en: Vegetable-oil production separates triglyceride oil from cleaned oil-bearing seeds and refines it to the required grade. Oilseeds,approved extraction solvent,water,refining alkali,bleaching media and steam as appropriate.
a.gu: Cleaned oil-bearing seedsમાંથી triglyceride oil અલગ કરીને જરૂરી grade સુધી refine કરવું એટલે vegetable-oil production. Oilseeds,approved extraction solvent,water,refining alkali,bleaching media તથા જરૂરી steam લેવાય છે.

q.en: Explain the principle of Hydrogenated oil product.

a.en: Oil hydrogenation adds hydrogen across some carbon–carbon double bonds to increase saturation and change melting/texture properties. Refined oil,hydrogen and a suitable controlled catalyst system,commonly nickel-based in the historical process.
a.gu: Oilના કેટલાક carbon–carbon double bonds પર hydrogen ઉમેરવાથી saturation તથા melting/texture બદલાય છે;તે oil hydrogenation છે. Refined oil,hydrogen તથા historical processમાં સામાન્ય nickel-based controlled catalyst system લેવાય છે.

q.en: Explain the principle of Sugar from sugar cane.

a.en: Cane-sugar manufacture extracts sucrose-containing juice,clarifies/concentrates it and separates sucrose crystals from mother liquor. Sugar cane,imbibition water and the selected clarification chemicals;the supplied reference labels lime,phosphate and SO2service.
a.gu: Sugar-cane juice extract કરીને clarify/concentrate કરવું તથા mother liquorથી sucrose crystals અલગ કરવા એટલે cane-sugar manufacture. Sugar cane,imbibition water તથા selected clarification chemicals;referenceમાં lime,phosphate તથા SO2service છે.

q.en: Explain the principle of Starch from maize.

a.en: Maize-starch manufacture separates starch granules from germ,fibre and protein by wet milling and density/size separation. Clean maize,controlled steeping water/media and washing water.
a.gu: Wet milling તથા density/size separationથી maizeના starch granulesને germ,fibre/proteinથી અલગ કરવા એટલે maize-starch manufacture. Clean maize,controlled steeping water/media તથા washing water લેવાય છે.

q.en: Explain the principle of Dextrin from starch.

a.en: Dextrins are lower-chain-length starch-conversion products obtained by controlled partial depolymerisation,not complete hydrolysis to glucose. Starch and the controlled acid-assisted gas/heat system in the supplied fluid-bed route.
a.gu: Controlled partial depolymerisationથી starchની chain length ઘટીને dextrins બને છે;આ complete glucose hydrolysis નથી. Starch તથા supplied fluid-bed routeની controlled acid-assisted gas/heat system લેવાય છે.

q.en: Explain the principle of Chemicals from the sea.

a.en: Seawater is a dilute mixed-electrolyte resource;evaporation concentrates brine and produces salt/bittern streams.Principal recovered products include NaCl,magnesium compounds,bromine and selected potassium salts,depending on brine composition and the recovery system.Seawater desalination also gives water butdoes not mean every dissolved ion is economically recovered. Salt is recovered by evaporation/crystallisation;magnesium can be precipitated as hydroxide and further processed;bromide is oxidised to recover bromine.NaCl serves food/chemical/chlor-alkali industries,magnesium compounds serve refractory/chemical uses,and bromine serves specialised chemical intermediates.Uncontrolled seawater discharge after chemical treatment is not acceptable merely because its original source was the sea.
a.gu: Seawater dilute mixed-electrolyte resource છે;evaporationથી brine concentrate થઈ salt/bittern streams બને છે. Composition/system પ્રમાણે NaCl,magnesium compounds,bromine તથા selected potassium salts મળે છે. Desalinationથી water પણ મળે છે,પરંતુ દરેક dissolved ionનું economic recovery થાય એવો અર્થ નથી. Salt evaporation/crystallisationથી,magnesium hydroxide precipitation તથા further processingથી અને bromide oxidationથી bromine recover થાય છે. NaCl food/chemical/chlor-alkali industriesમાં,magnesium compounds refractory/chemical usesમાં તથા bromine specialised intermediatesમાં વપરાય છે. Chemical treatment પછી uncontrolled discharge મૂળ seawater હતું એટલે યોગ્ય બનતું નથી.

q.en: Explain the principle of Bromine from seawater.

a.en: Bromine recovery from seawater converts dissolved bromide to volatile molecular bromine and concentrates/purifies it in an enclosed industrial recovery train. Seawater bromide,controlled acid/oxidant systems,air and the selected absorption chemistry.
a.gu: Dissolved bromideને volatile molecular bromineમાં ફેરવી enclosed industrial recovery trainમાં concentrate/purify કરવું એટલે seawaterમાંથી bromine recovery. Seawater bromide,controlled acid/oxidant systems,air તથા selected absorption chemistry લેવાય છે.
